definitions: A support, typically L-shaped, fixed to a wall or other surface to hold a shelf, lamp, or other object.
A category or group of people or things with similar characteristics or within a particular range.
Either of a pair of marks [ ] used to enclose words or figures so as to separate them from the rest of a text.
A triangular support at the junction of a wall and a roof.
examples: The shelf was held up by a sturdy bracket.
He falls into a higher tax bracket.
Please add the information in brackets.
The architect designed a decorative bracket for the eaves.
